title: Special Financing Plans and the Everyday Discount on Ridgeline Consumer Credit Purchases
content:
**Register financing terms — Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card purchases.**

- **Choosing a plan.** A single purchase charged to a revolving card may carry one special financing plan chosen at the register: 6-month deferred interest, 12-month deferred interest or 24-month deferred interest when the purchase is at least that plan's minimum and the plan is offered on the tier; or 84 equal monthly payments at the tier's reduced APR when the purchase is at least that plan's minimum and the plan is offered on the tier.
- **Standard plan.** With no choice, or no qualifying plan, the purchase is on the standard revolving plan.
- **No combining.** Special financing and the everyday discount are mutually exclusive on the same purchase: a purchase posted on any plan other than the standard revolving plan received no everyday discount, and a standard-plan purchase received the tier's everyday discount off at the register, so its posted amount is already net of the discount.
- **Promotional end date.** The promotional end date is the posting date plus the plan's 6, 12 or 24 months, on the same day of the month, or on the last day of that month when that day does not exist.
- **Deferred interest.** Deferred interest accrues on a deferred-interest purchase from its posting date at the purchase APR but is not charged when the promotional balance is paid in full by the promotional end date. When any of it is unpaid at the end of the promotional end date, all interest accrued on the full original promotional amount is charged on the next statement as an interest line of type deferred interest assessed, carrying the promotion's plan.
- **Project Loan draws.** Ridgeline Project Loan purchases post on the loan draw plan and may post only on or before the draw period end date.

## Promotional end dates (hypothetical postings)

| Posted | Plan | Promotional end date |
|---|---|---|
| 15 January | 12-month deferred interest | 15 January of the following year |
| 31 August | 6-month deferred interest | 28 February (29 February in a leap year) |
| 30 November | 24-month deferred interest | 30 November two years later |

## Paid in full or not (hypothetical 1200.00 promotional purchase)

| Promotional balance at the end of the promotional end date | Deferred interest charged |
|---|---|
| 0.00 | none |
| 0.01 | all interest accrued since posting on the full 1200.00 |

**Hypothetical everyday discount.** A 400.00 purchase on the standard plan of a tier with a 5.0 percent everyday discount posts at 380.00; the same purchase placed on 6-month deferred interest posts at 400.00.
